title: SolarWinds Network Configuration Manager ExportConfigs Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of SolarWinds Network Configuration Manager. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ExportConfigs method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
